about: every N64 input bindable (2026-11-19, roster_ctl): F2 > CONTROLS > KEYBOARD BUTTONS (P1) opened in the arcade's QA Royal Rumble (qa_op works there, not in a QA singles demo: logic.c qa_on 1 returns before the F2 menu) (qa_op 23), for a picture of the page as the bindings are. With a controls_n64.json put in the game folder first, the log's '[pads] ... in use' lines show its rows applied at start-up.

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30
